title: Kinetic captions
summary: Captions timed to a voice: the phrase sits dim, each word lights as it is said, key words land bigger, phrases change on a clean cut.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: script
params.default: Your agent writes the brief. You pick the look. It renders every frame. That is paper-motion.

params.name: perPage
params.description: most characters on one page of captions

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add kinetic-captions --name my-kinetic-captions
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-kinetic-captions/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-kinetic-captions/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.

beats.name: Captions
beats.what: each word lights as it is said; phrases change on a cut
